message.Title: Generally Available: Azure NetApp Files cache volumes

Body.Content:
Azure NetApp Files cache volumes is now Generally Available. Azure NetApp Files now support cache volumes, which are cloud-based caches of an external origin volume, containing only the most actively accessed data on the volume. This brings data and files closer to the user for faster throughput with a smaller footprint. Azure NetApp Files cache volumes simplify file distribution, reduces WAN latency, and lowers WAN/ExpressRoute bandwidth costs. 

Cache volumes is available in these regions.

Learn more: 

  • What's new in Azure NetApp Files 
  • Configure a cache volume for Azure NetApp Files 
  • Understand Azure NetApp Files cache volumes 
  • Change the service level of an Azure NetApp Files cache volume 
  • Manage file access logs in Azure NetApp Files cache volume 
  • Break file locks for an Azure NetApp Files cache volume 
  • Reset SMB password for an Azure NetApp Files cache volume
